brief: A view /counter with a counter: increment, decrement and reset buttons, shows whether the number is even or odd.
A view /todos: add tasks, mark done, delete, filter All/Active/Done, count of remaining tasks.

A view /login with an email + password form, client-side validation (email format, password >= 8 chars), shows errors under each field and disables the submit button while submitting (simulate with a 1s promise).
A view /products that loads a product list in load() (fake data: id, name, price, stock), shows a table with sorting by name or price and a text search box.
A view /product that receives one product from load() (fake data) and shows name, price, a stock badge (in stock / sold out) and an add-to-cart button that shows a confirmation message.
A view /settings with three tabs (Profile, Notifications, Security) implemented by hand with buttons and role=tablist semantics; each tab has a small form.
A view /team listing team members; clicking 'Remove' opens a confirmation dialog (<dialog>) with Cancel and Confirm; confirm removes the member.
A view /logs with 95 fake log entries generated in script, paginated 10 per page with Previous/Next buttons and 'page X of Y'.
A view /cart: line items with quantity steppers, remove button, subtotal, 16% tax and total formatted as currency; empty state when no items.
A view /search with an input that filters a list of 30 city names after a 300ms debounce (use fx with cleanup for the timer), showing the number of matches and an empty state.
A view /stopwatch with start, stop, lap and reset; shows elapsed mm:ss.cs and the list of laps. Clean up the interval.
A view /faq with 5 questions as an accordion; only one open at a time; buttons with aria-expanded.
A view /dashboard with 4 KPI cards (revenue, orders, customers, conversion) from load() and a list of the 5 latest orders with status badges.
A view /signup: 3-step wizard (account, profile, confirm) with Back/Next, a progress indicator 'Step N of 3', and a final summary.
A view /appearance with a toggle between light and dark preference stored in localStorage (read it on mount in fx), and a preview card.
A view /post with an article body and a comments section: list comments, add a comment with name and text (both required), newest first.
A view /board with three columns (To do, Doing, Done); each card has buttons to move it left or right; add a card to To do.
A view /catalog with checkbox filters by category, a price range select, and the list of matching items with the count; a 'Clear filters' button.
A view /contact with a contact form (name, email, topic select, message textarea), character counter for the message (max 500), and a success message after submit.
A view /users: table of users (name, email, role) with add, inline edit and delete; role is a select; validate email; show 'No users' when empty.
A view /invoice showing an invoice with line items, quantities, unit prices, subtotal, discount input (percent) and total.
A view /weather that loads a 5-day forecast in load() (fake data) and shows each day with min/max temperature and a toggle °C/°F.
A view /profile with a form to edit display name, bio (max 160 chars with counter) and a save button that shows 'Saved'.
A view /notifications listing notifications with read/unread state, 'mark all as read' and a filter Unread only.
A view /calendar showing the days of the current month in a 7-column grid with previous/next month buttons.
A view /pomodoro with a 25-minute work timer and 5-minute break, start/pause/reset, and a session counter. Clean up the interval.
A view /palette where the user adds colors by hex input, sees swatches with their hex value, and can remove them.
A view /quiz with 5 multiple-choice questions shown one at a time, score at the end and a restart button.
A view /expenses: add expenses (description, amount, category select), list them, total per category.
A view /password with a password input that shows a strength meter (weak/medium/strong) and the rules met.
A view /convert that converts between km, miles and meters as the user types, both directions.
A view /tip: bill amount, tip percent buttons (10/15/20) and number of people; shows tip and total per person.
A view /chat with a message list and an input to send messages; each message shows author and time; newest at the bottom.
A view /files listing files (name, size, modified date) with sorting by any column and a selected-row highlight.
A view /groceries: add items with quantity, check them off, and a 'remove checked' button.
A view /bmi with height (cm) and weight (kg) inputs, computes BMI and shows the category.
A view /launch with a countdown to a fixed date showing days, hours, minutes and seconds. Clean up the timer.
A view /books: add books (title, author), mark as read, rate 1–5 stars with buttons, filter by read/unread.
A view /habits: list of habits with 7 checkboxes for the days of the week and a weekly completion percentage.
A view /recipe showing ingredients for a number of servings; changing servings scales the quantities.
A view /poll with a question, 4 options as radio buttons, a vote button and the results as percentages after voting.
A view /leaderboard loading players with scores in load(), sorted descending, with the top 3 highlighted.
A view /docs with a sidebar list of 6 sections and a content area; clicking a section shows its content and updates a breadcrumb.
A view /track showing an order's steps (placed, packed, shipped, delivered) with the current step highlighted.
A view /pricing with 3 plans, a monthly/yearly toggle that changes the prices (yearly 20% off), and a highlighted recommended plan.
A view /newsletter with an email input, validation, consent checkbox required, and a thank-you state after submit.
A view /gallery with 8 images (with alt text) in a grid; clicking one opens it larger in a <dialog> with next/previous.
A view /inventory: table of products with stock; buttons to add or remove stock; rows with stock below 5 are flagged.
A view /rsvp: event details and a form with name, number of guests (1–5 select) and dietary notes; shows a confirmation.
A view /notes with a textarea and a live character and word count, plus a list of saved notes.
A view /jobs loading job posts in load() with filters by remote/onsite and by seniority, and a count of results.
A view /seats with a 6×8 grid of seat buttons; taken seats are disabled; selected seats and total price are shown.
A view /rates showing exchange rates from load() with a base amount input that multiplies every rate.
A view /tickets: list of tickets with priority badges, status select per ticket, and a filter by status.
A view /onboarding with a checklist of 5 setup tasks, a progress bar with percentage and a 'complete' message at 100%.
A view /keys listing API keys (masked), with buttons to reveal one, copy it (show 'Copied'), and revoke it with confirmation.
A view /directory loading people in load() with a search box and grouping by department.
A view /metrics with a table of 10 metrics and a toggle to show only metrics that changed more than 5%.
A view /booking with date input, time slot buttons (9:00–17:00 hourly), selected slot and a confirm button.
A view /help with a search box filtering FAQ entries and showing how many matched.
A view /privacy with page content and a cookie consent panel with accept all, reject, and save preferences (3 checkboxes).
A view /player with a playlist of 6 songs, play/pause, next/previous and the current song highlighted (no real audio).
A view /address with street, city, state select, postal code (5 digits) and country, with per-field errors.
A view /checkout with an order summary and a coupon input; code SAVE10 applies 10%, others show an error.
A view /review with a 1–5 star rating control made of buttons, a review textarea and a submit that shows the review.
A view /welcome with text in English, Spanish and Portuguese and buttons to switch language.
A view /sales loading 30 sales in load(), with a date range (two date inputs) and a total of the filtered sales.
A view /sprint with columns To do / In progress / Done where In progress allows at most 3 cards (show a warning).
A view /contacts: alphabetical contact list grouped by first letter, with add and delete.
A view /loan with amount, annual rate and years, showing the monthly payment and total interest.
A view /blog loading posts in load() with title, date, excerpt and tags; clicking a tag filters the list.
A view /preferences with 5 toggle switches (checkboxes with labels) and a 'reset to defaults' button.
A view /text-stats with a textarea, live counts of characters, words and sentences, and reading time.
A view /roles with a matrix of users × permissions as checkboxes, and a save button that shows a summary of changes.
A view /stocks with 5 symbols whose prices change every 2 seconds (simulated) with up/down indicators. Clean up the interval.
A view /survey with 3 questions (text, radio, checkbox group) and a summary of the answers after submit.
A view /schedule showing a weekly timetable (Mon–Fri × 8 hours) from load(), with today's column highlighted.
A view /uploads simulating file uploads: an 'add file' button adds a row with a progress bar that fills over 3 seconds.
A view /order with product select, quantity, delivery option radios (standard/express +$50) and a live total.
A view /maintenance showing a maintenance message, an estimated time, and a 'retry' button that re-checks a fake status.
A view /compare with 3 phones side by side in a table and checkboxes to choose which spec rows to show.
A view /tags with an input that adds a tag on Enter, shows tags as chips with remove buttons, no duplicates.
A view /traffic loading 7 days of visits in load() and drawing a simple bar chart with divs and heights in %.
A view /ideas: list of ideas with upvote/downvote buttons, sorted by score, and a form to add an idea.
A view /account showing plan, renewal date and usage bars (storage, seats) from load(), and an upgrade button.
A view /returns with an order number input, a reason select, a details textarea and a status after submit.
A view /memory with 12 cards (6 pairs) face down; flip two, keep matched pairs open, count moves.
A view /tictactoe: 3×3 board of buttons, alternating X and O, winner detection and reset.
A view /playlist: search a list of 20 songs and add/remove them to a playlist with total duration.
A view /grades: students with 3 grades each, average per student, class average, and failing students highlighted.
A view /tour with 4 slides (heading + text), previous/next buttons, dot buttons and 'slide N of 4'.
A view /signals simulating a traffic light cycling red→green→yellow every 2 seconds with start/stop. Clean up the interval.
A view /invite with a list of email inputs (add/remove rows), validation, and a 'send invites' summary.
A view /parking with an entry time input and exit time input, computing hours and the fee ($20/hour, max $150).
A view /admin-products: table with add/edit/delete products (name, price, category), validation and empty state.
A view /report loading weekly KPIs in load() with change vs last week as +/− percentages colored ok/bad.
A view /access with a list of login events from load(), a filter by result (success/failed) and a count of failed logins.
A view /shortcuts listing keyboard shortcuts in a table with a search box that filters by action or key.
A view /garden with a list of plants, each with a watering interval in days and a 'watered today' button that resets its counter.
A view /loans listing borrowed books with due dates from load(), overdue ones flagged, and a 'return' button per book.
